record_type: R15 mechanism execution lineage and activation contract
design_source: MECHANISM_PROTOCOL.json is already fixed in the primary numerical source before the primary confirmatory outcomes.
activation: First create the immutable mechanism-source commit and source package. After the complete primary workflow finishes, create mechanism-execute pointing at exactly the same commit; do not change its source files or protocol.
candidate_source: Selected NBO weights retain their primary numerical source and method fingerprint. The separate mechanism numerical source identifies new assessment computation only.
evidence_join: The mechanism evidence commit retains both the mechanism source and main evidence commit as parents, and reuses the exact existing main experiment Git subtree. No historical raw evidence is duplicated under new paths.
